usedFor: DocuSeal holds forms and submissions, and “Form Completed” can trigger “Share File With Anyone” on a Google Drive file.

bestTemplate.name: “Form Completed” in DocuSeal, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A completed form means a file is ready to hand over, with Viewer, Commenter or Editor access set.

watchOut: “Form Viewed” and “Form Declined” fire here too, so pick the DocuSeal trigger allowed to hand out a link.
